title: How to Wash a Down Jacket

seo.title: How to Wash a Down Jacket
seo.meta_description: Wash a down jacket according to its care label with compatible detergent and thorough rinsing, then dry it completely while restoring loft to the insulation.
seo.search_intent: Wash a down-filled jacket without clumping the insulation, trapping detergent, or storing the garment while the down is still damp.

excerpt: The hard part of washing a down jacket is not just the wash cycle. The insulation has to rinse clean and dry all the way through without remaining in wet clumps.
content_html:
The care label comes first because down jackets differ in shell fabric, water-repellent treatments, stitching, and fill. If machine washing is allowed, prepare the garment before the cycle.

Empty pockets and secure closures

Brush off dry soil and spot-treat stains with a compatible product. Close zippers and hook-and-loop tabs that can snag the shell.

Use a small amount of compatible detergent

A down-specific wash or the product recommended by the jacket maker helps limit residue. Fabric softener can interfere with finishes and is generally unnecessary.

Prioritize thorough rinsing

Down can retain detergent. An extra rinse may help when the garment label and washer permit it and suds remain.

Drying is the critical stage

If tumble drying is permitted, use low heat and pause periodically to gently break apart down clumps. Clean dryer balls may help where the manufacturer allows them. Expect drying to take time.

Do not store until the fill is dry throughout

A cool, heavy, or compact area can still hold moisture even when the shell feels dry. Continue drying patiently to prevent musty odor and mold.

A technical shell, leather trim, or professional-clean-only label changes the method; do not apply a generic down-jacket routine to every garment.

faq.question: Can I use fabric softener?
faq.answer: It is generally avoided on down garments because it can leave residue and affect performance finishes.

faq.question: Why is the down clumped after washing?
faq.answer: Wet down naturally groups together; gentle movement and complete drying restore much of the loft.

faq.question: How can I tell when it is dry?
faq.answer: There should be no cool, heavy, damp, or compact clumps inside the jacket.
